phase_prompt.label: The Waiting Array
phase_prompt.summary: The Faithful stand as the silent, authenticated witnesses to the corruption of the system, holding their ground in the dark sectors.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Medium cinematic shot, The Congregation of the Faithful, hyper-realistic. A group of stoic figures in dark, heavy robes standing in a dim, data-fogged environment. Their robes have subtle glowing amber threads. They look upward with expressions of weary endurance. Illuminating their faces is the soft light from the data-glass tablets in their hands. Background features vertical streaks of data-rain and the faint grid of the simulation boundary. Dramatic lighting, high emotional weight, detailed skin textures, wet eyes. Octane render, ray-tracing, photorealistic.
